book.title: Make It Stick
book.author: Peter C. Brown, Henry L. Roediger III and Mark A. McDaniel

predict.question: On a ten-question mock practice quiz with the answers hidden, you have a 50% chance on each question. What score do you expect?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Make It Stick argues retrieval practice can support durable learning.
modelBoundary: Shown answers yield {A}%; hidden answers {B}%, because we assigned different item probabilities. Neither is a measured learning gain.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Recognition support and unaided retrieval are different tests; durable benefits require research.
